title: Display smoothed beliefs and a decoded path
description: You compare terminal belief displays and read the Viterbi coordinates.

steps.description: You compute backward messages and pass them with beliefs to smooth. A separate viterbi call produces the decoded state path.
You convert the final filtered and smoothed belief vectors to grids. Each gets its own labeled heatmap.

steps.question: What representation does vj use for each decoded state?
steps.answer: ij converts each flat state index to a row-column pair using W. vj stores those pairs in path order.

steps.description: You print the decoded positions. The recorded path starts at (4,5), repeats some positions, and ends at (0,6).
